name: @agents-store/trigger-dev
description: Trigger.dev dev plugin for Agents Store. Comprehensive development knowledge for building background tasks, AI agent workflows, and durable execution on self-hosted Trigger.dev v4 (baseline server 4.4.4; newer features are marked with the server version they need) — SDK patterns, CLI recipes, deployment, full 41-tool MCP reference, TRQL queries and dashboards, managed prompts, chat agents, dev-server control, realtime API, and troubleshooting.
